mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NM AS userNm, EMAIL AS email, USE_YN AS useYn FROM ADMIN_USER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT R.ROLE_ID FROM ADMIN_USER_ROLE UR JOIN ADMIN_ROLE R ON UR.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT R.ROLE_CD FROM ADMIN_USER_ROLE UR JOIN ADMIN_ROLE R ON UR.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{value} AND UR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT DISTINCT M.MENU_ID AS menuId, M.UP_MENU_ID AS upMenuId, M.MENU_NM AS menuNm, M.MENU_URL AS menuUrl, M.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, M.USE_YN AS useYn, M.REMARK AS remark, LEVEL AS lvl FROM ADMIN_USER_ROLE UR JOIN ADMIN_ROLE_MENU RM ON UR.ROLE_ID = RM.ROLE_ID AND RM.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN ADMIN_MENU M ON RM.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{value} AND UR.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH M.UP_MENU_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR M.MENU_ID = M.UP_MENU_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY M.SORT_ORD, M.MENU_ID
